=============================================

This directory contains 3D assets generated by Meshy AI (https://www.meshy.ai).

License: Per Meshy AI's terms of service, AI-generated content from paid
user accounts is licensed to the user for commercial and non-commercial use.
Reference: https://docs.meshy.ai/ and Meshy AI Terms of Service at time of
generation.

User / License holder: taylorhadfield1@gmail.com
Generation date: 2026-04-22 (downloaded by user)

Distribution restrictions:
- Do not re-upload or re-sell the raw Meshy output as stock asset content.
- Derivative works (our cloaked/modified variants) are fine and unrestricted
  per Meshy's commercial license.

Storage notes:
- These .glb binaries are intentionally NOT committed to the OdysseyEngine
  repository (see .gitignore rules for third_party/meshy_imports/**).
- This directory serves as the agent-side authoring source. Derivative
  outputs suitable for engine consumption live in demo/showcase/assets/.
